description: This PHP class provides helper methods for generating pagination metadata and links for API responses within the SuiteCRM project. It utilizes the Slim framework's Request object to build URLs for pagination navigation.

classes.name: PaginationObjectHelper
classes.description: A helper class for constructing pagination-related response data, including metadata and navigation links, using information from HTTP requests.

methods.name: getPaginationMeta
methods.description: Generates a MetaResponse object containing total pages and records on the current page.

methods.name: getPaginationLinks
methods.description: Creates PaginationResponse with links for first, previous, next, and last pages based on current page number and total pages.

methods.name: createPaginationLink
methods.description: Constructs a URL for a specific page number by modifying the query parameters of the current request URI.
